name: hypre
description: Parallel solvers for sparse linear systems featuring multigrid methods. OpenSWMM overlay: SEQUENTIAL build (HYPRE_ENABLE_MPI=OFF) so it carries no MPI dependency — BoomerAMG is used single-process via mpistubs (MPI_COMM_WORLD). Uses external BLAS/LAPACK on Linux/macOS; on Windows uses hypre's bundled C BLAS/LAPACK to avoid the lapack-reference Fortran/LLVMFlang toolchain conflict.
